purpose: Qualify the bounded Ross candidate, not just the independent reference, for continuation after the 1 cm surface cap while excess atmospheric supply is routed through an explicit conservative runoff ledger. Compare candidate and independent-reference trajectories from the same four A4 cap checkpoints over the independently confirmed A6-R1 time partition.

frozen_physical_identity.cap_states: exactly the four A4/A6/A6-R1 O14 cap checkpoints

candidate_authority.surface_face: qualified E3E-R2R3 bounded 5 cm candidate including R2P endpoint semantics and R3 physical-envelope-certified snap
candidate_authority.internal_faces: existing qualified C1R/R3 bounded candidate routes only
candidate_authority.c1r_table: generated once per profile as shared immutable qualification fixture; not per-column persistent state

reference_authority.surface_face: independent endpoint-aware high-accuracy 5 cm reference used by A6-R1
reference_authority.internal_faces: independent 10 cm steady-Darcy reference used by A6-R1

per_step_water_identity.rule: runoff must be nonnegative; excess supply is never reapplied as soil forcing and surface storage is never clipped as an unbooked loss

cost_and_state_guards.runoff: result/ledger transfer owned outside soil-face kernel

hard_guards: Do not change the four cap states, 1 cm cap, 12*KSAT supply, bottom head, 40x0.025 d partition or frozen tolerances after execution.
Do not force h0=0; A6/A6-R1 established an unsaturated attractor in this topology.
Do not use the independent reference as a production path or as a second candidate trajectory.
Do not add new persistent state to remember the attractor.
Do not clip negative runoff or surface storage; any such case fails closed.
Do not infer other materials or other surface caps from this O14-only gate.

architecture_checks.5_worker_scratch: Candidate/reference nonlinear vectors are qualification-worker scratch.
architecture_checks.7_transactionality: Each solve reads a committed immutable input state and commits only after all mass/route checks pass.
architecture_checks.9_generic_time: Generic 1 day horizon partitioned into 40 explicit intervals, no calendar assumptions.
architecture_checks.13_mass_conservation: 1e-9 cm hard gate with explicit runoff and bottom transfers; no repair/clipping.
architecture_checks.15_coupling_cost: No duplicated candidate trajectory for comparison; expensive reference is qualification-only.
architecture_checks.23_solver_policy: Ross candidate numerical route remains separate from runoff physical composition.
architecture_checks.25_reference_mode: Independent reference trajectory remains available and separate.
architecture_checks.28_runtime_composition: Surface cap and runoff ledger are outside the soil-face kernel.

hard_nonclaims: No automatic detection of runoff onset or changing surface cap.
No caps other than 1 cm, no forcing other than frozen 12*KSAT and no other material than O14.
No response tangent qualification during runoff continuation.
No production implementation, runtime, MultiSWAP, MODFLOW or groundwater admission.
